parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Market-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104 | 2.86 | 2.86
2 | 186 | 2.38 | 5.24
3 | 266 | 24.7 | 29.9
4 | 327 | 24.6 | 54.6
5 | 219 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Market-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AAK type
Aquifer depth: >54.6 m (Layer 5, ρ = 219 Ω·m, beginning at the base of Layer 4)
Recommendation: Target drilling depth should extend to at least 65–70 m to fully penetrate the resistive Layer 4 cap and reach the lower-resistivity Layer 5, which is interpreted as the main water-bearing horizon; set well screens below 54.6 m to tap this saturated zone.
